decision: Retain preparation fused into the existing DeltaNet head dispatch for chunks >=128. P512 serial-request prefill improves in all three paired rounds. Other prompt lengths show no reliable improvement; noisy cold-process latency results are not a speed claim.
timing_label_correction: Intermediate case names containing greedy used forced output tokens and measure a duplicate full-logit path. Original identifiers and raw profiles are preserved. Actual unforced greedy correctness checks are separate.
